id.description: persistent UUID; derived from 'missions:<name>' when omitted

objectives.description: ALL must complete: [{ id, kind: reach|collect|kill|interact, target, count >= 1, x, z, radius >= 0, conditions }]

dialogue.description: dialogue graph: [{ id (must include 'start'), speaker, text, choices: [{ text, next, conditions }] }]

unlockConditions.description: ALL must pass to accept: [{ kind: flag|counter|objectiveDone|attribute, key, op: ==|!=|>=|<=|>|<, value, flagValue }]

reward.description: { itemId, count >= 0, xp >= 0, setFlag } applied on completion
